test.title: Section 1 · a theatre and dog care

paragraphs.text: Westfield Theatre — booking information. The box office is open from 10 am to 6 pm, Monday to Saturday, and until the start of the performance on show days. Tickets can also be booked online at no extra cost or by telephone, although a charge of £1.50 is added to each telephone booking. Tickets for the Christmas show go on sale on 1 September and usually sell out within a few weeks, so early booking is advised.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Seats in the stalls are closest to the stage, while the circle, upstairs, gives the best view of dance performances. Four wheelchair spaces are available in the stalls and must be booked by telephone, and a companion seat next to each space is free. For some performances a signed or captioned version is offered, and these are marked in the programme with a symbol.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Tickets cannot be refunded, but they can be exchanged for another performance of the same show up to forty-eight hours before the original date, for a fee of £2 per ticket. Latecomers will be admitted only at a suitable break in the performance, which may be up to twenty minutes after the start. Children under three are not admitted, except to the special relaxed performances held on Saturday mornings.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Paws on the Park. Group walks of up to six dogs, twice a day, on weekdays only. Every walker holds a first-aid certificate for animals, and dogs are collected from and returned to your home. Before the first walk, we meet you and your dog at home at no charge, to check that your dog is comfortable with other dogs. Walks are paid for monthly in advance.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Ashby Dog Hotel. Overnight boarding in heated indoor kennels with an outdoor run, for anything from one night to four weeks. Dogs must be up to date with their vaccinations, and owners are asked to bring the dog’s usual food to avoid stomach upsets. Visitors are welcome to look round by appointment, and a daily photograph of your dog can be sent by text message.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Home from Home. Instead of going into kennels, your dog stays in the house of one of our carers, who look after no more than two dogs at a time. We try to match each dog with a carer who has a similar pet. Short-notice bookings are accepted whenever a carer is available, and a trial day, charged at half price, is recommended before a longer stay.
paragraphs.label: C

document.title: Section 1 · a theatre and dog care

topic.en: Two everyday texts: booking rules at a theatre, and three dog-care services.
topic.kk: Екі тұрмыстық мәтін: театрда билет брондау ережесі және итке күтім жасайтын үш қызмет.
topic.ru: Два бытовых текста: правила бронирования в театре и три службы по уходу за собаками.

items.quote: Tickets can also be booked online at no extra cost or by telephone, although a charge of £1.50 is added to each telephone booking.
items.prompt: Reserving seats by phone is more expensive than reserving them through the website.

explanation.en: Online is “at no extra cost”, by phone there is “a charge of £1.50” → TRUE: phoning costs more.
explanation.kk: Онлайн «at no extra cost», телефонмен «a charge of £1.50» → TRUE: телефонмен қымбатырақ.
explanation.ru: Онлайн «at no extra cost», по телефону «a charge of £1.50» → TRUE: по телефону дороже.

items.quote: usually sell out within a few weeks
items.prompt: Seats for the Christmas show are normally still easy to get in December.
keywords: sell out within a few weeks

explanation.en: On sale from 1 September and they “usually sell out within a few weeks” → FALSE: by December they are normally gone.
explanation.kk: Сатылым 1 қыркүйектен, «usually sell out within a few weeks» → FALSE: желтоқсанға дейін билет әдетте қалмайды.
explanation.ru: Продажа с 1 сентября, «usually sell out within a few weeks» → FALSE: к декабрю билетов обычно нет.

items.quote: the circle, upstairs, gives the best view of dance performances
items.prompt: Dance is best seen from the seats nearest the stage.

explanation.en: “the circle, upstairs, gives the best view of dance performances” → FALSE. The stalls are closest, but dance is best seen from upstairs.
explanation.kk: «the circle, upstairs, gives the best view of dance performances» → FALSE. Сахнаға ең жақыны — партер (stalls), бірақ биді жоғарыдан көрген дұрыс.
explanation.ru: «the circle, upstairs, gives the best view of dance performances» → FALSE. Ближе всего к сцене партер (stalls), но танец лучше смотреть с балкона.

items.quote: For some performances a signed or captioned version is offered
items.prompt: A signed version of a show is offered once a month.

explanation.en: “For some performances” — they exist and are marked in the programme; how often is not stated → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: «For some performances» — мұндай көрсетілім бар әрі бағдарламада белгіленеді; қаншалықты жиі — айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: «For some performances» — сказано, что такие показы есть, и их отмечают в программе; как часто — не сказано → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: except to the special relaxed performances held on Saturday mornings
items.prompt: Tickets for the relaxed performances cost less than tickets for other shows.

explanation.en: We learn only that children under three may attend and that they are on Saturday mornings; price is not mentioned → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Жайлы көрсетілімге үш жасқа толмаған бала кіре алатыны және ол сенбі күні таңертең өтетіні ғана айтылған; бағасы туралы жоқ → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: О спокойных показах сказано только, что туда пускают детей до трёх лет и что они по субботам утром; о цене нет ничего → NOT GIVEN.

groups.instruction: Do the following statements agree with the information given in Text A? Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.

items.quote: for a fee of £2 per ticket
items.prompt: Cost of moving to another date: 6 ____ for each seat

explanation.en: “for a fee of £2 per ticket” → £2. £1.50 is the telephone booking charge.
explanation.kk: «for a fee of £2 per ticket» → £2. £1.50 — телефонмен брондаудың қосымша ақысы.
explanation.ru: «for a fee of £2 per ticket» → £2. £1.50 — доплата за бронь по телефону.

items.quote: up to forty-eight hours before the original date
items.prompt: Changes allowed until 7 ____ before the original performance

explanation.en: “up to forty-eight hours before the original date” → forty-eight hours.
explanation.kk: «up to forty-eight hours before the original date» → forty-eight hours: одан кейін билетті ауыстыруға болмайды.
explanation.ru: «up to forty-eight hours before the original date» → forty-eight hours.

items.quote: which may be up to twenty minutes after the start
items.prompt: Late arrivals may have to wait up to 8 ____ to go in

explanation.en: “which may be up to twenty minutes after the start” → twenty minutes: latecomers wait for a suitable break.
explanation.kk: «which may be up to twenty minutes after the start» → twenty minutes: кешіккендер ыңғайлы үзілісте кіргізіледі.
explanation.ru: «which may be up to twenty minutes after the start» → twenty minutes: опоздавших пускают в подходящую паузу.

groups.title: Changing a booking and arriving late
groups.instruction: Complete the notes below about Text A. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer.

items.quote: a daily photograph of your dog can be sent by text message
items.prompt: Owners can get a picture of their pet every day.

explanation.en: “a daily photograph of your dog can be sent by text message” → B.
explanation.kk: «a daily photograph of your dog can be sent by text message» → B: итіңіздің суретін күн сайын жібереді.
explanation.ru: «a daily photograph of your dog can be sent by text message» → B.

items.quote: we meet you and your dog at home at no charge
items.prompt: The first meeting with the service costs nothing.

explanation.en: “we meet you and your dog at home at no charge” → A. C also has a trial first, but it is half price, not free.
explanation.kk: «we meet you and your dog at home at no charge» → A. C-дағы сынақ күні де алдын ала өтеді, бірақ ол тегін емес, жарты бағамен.
explanation.ru: «we meet you and your dog at home at no charge» → A. Пробный день в C тоже бывает до основного бронирования, но он за полцены, а не бесплатно.

items.quote: your dog stays in the house of one of our carers
items.prompt: The dog stays in a private house rather than in kennels.
keywords: house of one of our carers

explanation.en: “your dog stays in the house of one of our carers” → C. In A the dog is collected from home, but only for a walk.
explanation.kk: «your dog stays in the house of one of our carers» → C. A-да да итті үйден алып кетеді, бірақ тек серуенге.
explanation.ru: «your dog stays in the house of one of our carers» → C. В A собаку тоже забирают из дома, но только на прогулку.

items.quote: owners are asked to bring the dog’s usual food to avoid stomach upsets
items.prompt: Owners should supply the meals their animal normally eats.

explanation.en: “owners are asked to bring the dog’s usual food” → B. “Normally eats” = “usual food”.
explanation.kk: «owners are asked to bring the dog’s usual food» → B. «Normally eats» мен «usual food» — бір мағына.
explanation.ru: «owners are asked to bring the dog’s usual food» → B. «Normally eats» = «usual food».

items.quote: Group walks of up to six dogs, twice a day, on weekdays only.
items.prompt: This service does not operate on Saturdays and Sundays.

explanation.en: “on weekdays only” → A: there are no walks at weekends.
explanation.kk: «on weekdays only» → A: демалыс күндері серуен болмайды.
explanation.ru: «on weekdays only» → A: в выходные прогулок нет.
